title: Artfully Absurd: Holiday Havoc
seo_title: Artfully Absurd: Holiday Havoc in Joplin, MO
description: Artfully Absurd: Holiday Havoc is a night of silly holiday art-making where you can make resin ornaments, failed gingerbread houses, unhinged greeting cards, and cardboard ugly sweater models, followed by a photo shoot. It is for adults only, no artistic talent is required, and admission includes food, art activities, and two drink tickets (alcoholic or nonalcoholic); members get $5 off with a code from the organizer. It takes place Friday, December 4, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at Spiva Center for the Arts, 212 W 7th St, Joplin, MO.
